reviews.text: A good place to visit and enjoy the day BUT since its an outdoor activity, please note the weather and seasons. During peak season, its no doubt with be beautiful and magnificent but off season, the trees could be very plain. The boat ride is nice but during off season could be very quiet. There are guide on the boat ride but only in Chinese. Non Chinese speaking tourist would find this challenging. The get off and on boat during each stop is not the same location and can be a bit tricky.

Went there in winter with a guide. A guide is highly recommended for non-Chinese speakers as a lot of the information there is in Chinese. Very expansive park with many canals and a deep history. Also the home of the dragon boat race. If you want less crowding, I would recommend to go in winter. If you want more scenery, go in autumn or spring.

Xixi national werland Park is really a treasure, it’s a very big park so I walked a lot. The place is tranquil and beautiful and it seems to go back in time. I had fun searching for shrines, little houses and bridges 🌳🦋

Nice big wetland with canals for boat rides but unfortunately the guides on the boats don’t speak any English. Also where are all the birds? A wetland park like this should be teeming with water birds, but all I have seen so far is one duck and one Herron. Plenty of places to buy food and drinks at the boat piers. Finally if you have difficulty walking the paving of the footpaths is quite uneven.

Top ❤️. One of the top places in all China ❤️. Worth the travel, must visit during a trip in East China, for a well-preserved wetland scenery, animals and plants, temples and traditional buildings 😊✨👍

It's a very big natural park with greenery & colors. Different types of Trees, Flowers, mini streams pond available. Also mini Tulip festival happens in April. Avery good place to pass a day with Family & kids. Amazing place.

What a beautiful wetland park, and the ticket is free. The scenic area is very large. We stayed at the Sheraton Hotel next to it and spent 6 days visiting the park. We took a walk in the park every morning. It was full of green trees, birds and flowers. It was a pity that there was too little tourist content available on Google Maps. Basically, there was no information on this map. I hope foreign tourists will download local maps. Hangzhou has a lot of food and attractions.

A city park in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province. It is full of lakes, ponds, streams and greenery. A lovely place to walk and there is a lot of wildlife there, despite what some reviews say. I saw invertebrates, amphibians, birds, fish, and one mammal (a bat) in the space of about 3 hours. There are also plenty of food vendors, shops, and some museums and art exhibitions. Entry to the park is free, but the boat trips, hot air balloon, and Gao's mansion all cost, I think. Well worth a visit if you are in or near Hangzhou.

It is a local park and attraction. CNY 80 entrance fee, which I thought is a bit high. There isn’t much to see. The staff at the information counter isn’t too helpful and patient. Maybe it is nicer during spring time when flower blossom.
Huge national park. Nice during sunny weather but not my top priority. Join a boat tour if weather and time allows.

Great environment here. The boat master is very experienced. He knows a little history about the place, will sing and introduce the place for us. Natural views that are well maintained from the emperor’s generation. Boat tickets a little expensive for one/ two hours ride. Smooth and stable experience on the boat itself. No dizziness nor bad experience.

Pleasant park with lots of walking paths. Plenty of small restaurants within the park boundary. We stayed overnight at a charming hotel called the Xixi Fan Yuan Hotel (凡云酒店） which was walking distance to a museum, a “walking street” with eateries and arts and craft shops.

Xixi National Wetland Park in Hangzhou, China, is a really pretty place with small lakes, water ways and lots of nature. It has a peaceful walking path and has traditional buildings and wooden Chinese architecture. You can even take a boat ride and enjoy the quiet and beautiful surroundings. Tour bus is also available inside the garden to make it comfortable for the visitors. Refer to my photos for a perfect glimpse of the garden. Enjoy!

A 5A rated natural park with numerous ponds and water channels. It is impossible to enjoy the whole view of this place in one day. Just seat on a boat and sailing between island or under small bridges. This area is well preserved, in spite of its near a huge city.

Pretty cool wetland to visit, however, seems a bit over-priced. Even though they say it's a natural wetland, I will feel like it's geared towards tourists too much, so the convenience of boat rides, shops, and little restaurants among the wetland area gave me a feeling that it ISN'T so natural. The roads have been paved over the land to make easy access for tourists, and that contradicts the concept of wetland to me. Also, the explanations done by the tour guide on the boat was only available in Chinese, so I assume I missed a lot of important information to get to know this wetland area better. I still like the fact that China is putting consideration in creating wetlands, which are good for species habitat and water. I wish the tour would involve less civilization and give a chance for more engaging experience of the nature itself.

Beautiful wetlands, calm oasis if you can avoid the crowds. There are interesting shops in here, e.g. homemade rice wine etc. boat tours are worth it, and you can see much of the park this way. get off and walk wherever you can.

Last month i was joined this activities. The name of this activity is “beauty run” . The location in xixi wetland national park this place are very beautifull they have many a lot of garden and many kinds of flower in this area. You can enjoy with your friend to make some picnic or look around their nature. So fresh air and their facilities are nice. Don’t worry about the price. I think it’s not expensive to enter this attractions.
Great wetland park. Best is to tour it on boat. There is also a very nice hotel inside the park and you can only get to the rooms by boat.

This place is really recommended place, just near the west lake, and also near Alibaba, super large, it takes 2 days to finish all the park, if you only have half or 1 day, then just take the main route, get inside from Zhoujiacun, and recommend you take enter ticket + boat ticket together, because the boat ticket is really great and comfortable, the boat ticket can get off and get in 4 times on 4 different ports, when you get off the boat, take your time, and go to the next port and wait for the boat to the next port, BTW, if you don't want to buy the ticket, it's also ok, because half of the park are free to public and also very beautiful

The signage is poor, and I missed many buildings in side park. The only way to explore is by boat, which only goes one way. The electric boat only goes to the right side of the paid area, and I don't know how to get to the left. The park is large, and the signage is poor, making it difficult to see the entire . There are no famous attractions.

For some reason the Chinese play music here, which you can hear over the natural nature sounds. They have speakers set up on poles. It’s hard to avoid being near the music. So, you won’t feel like you’re completely escaping to nature here, but otherwise, it’s enjoyable to walk around and visit the local restaurants.
It's a wetland that used to have residents. Now it's a tourist attraction. Fishing or fruit-gathering festival are held throughout the year.
30 minutes drive from west lake.A bit crowded wet land park. There is a shop where they sell farmed pearls. You even have an option to choose the oyster and they open and take out pearls.

Xixi National Wetland Park is a nice place to understand the wetlands, the area is huge and also with nice scenery. The wetland is good for both photos taking and educational. They have a museum located on east west of the wetland, and it is free of charge. They have both pay and non-paid area inside the wetland, if you don't wanna enjoy the view and restaurants there, non-paid area is good enough for you.But you are looking for deep view of the wetland, you will need to pay and enter the wetland, and enjoy the boat ride inside

Very Beautiful Very Romantic You can enjoy it a lot There are different attractions available for different people You can see live pearls coming out from sea shells You can use pearls as a bracelet etc You can enjoy boating Planning of this park is really awesome Lots of bamboo trees Sound of water Sound of air Sound of birds Couples used to come there right after marriage for honeymoon

Loved biking through the path in the free section of this park. There is plenty to see and enjoy even if you don't enter the paid areas: ponds, gardens, pagodas, special shops... The wetlands museum in the south west corner is also free, just not the observation tower beside it.

Nice and quiet place outside of Hangzhou city. The Wetlands area is great for morning runs, and you'll find company as early as 6am on good days - elderly folks doing taichi, young people running, dog-walking etc. Amongs the wetlands are various "folies" or art sculptures that accent the landscape, lending a very nice touch of colour and surprise sometimes, as u explore.
I thought it would be much more interesting, but maybe its just me used to wetlands. Those who like nature, birds, water will enjoy it
Its nature.... it's peaceful..... Been there four times already.... And something tools me I'll be going back for some more
Such a huge place to roam around. Looks beautiful in the rains. Lots of shops to buy souvenirs.
西溪國家濕地公園 又叫西溪濕地 位於浙江省杭州市西部 是歷史上著名的 西湖、西溪、西泠⋯杭州三西之一 西溪溼地佔地面積廣闊 有分收費區和免費區 今天我只走免費區 但是也走了15000步😂 園區內栽種許多的植物和花 五顏六色繽紛多彩 初夏池塘裡荷花蓮花慢慢綻放中 非常迷人漂亮 參觀日當天下雨 更增添許多迷人的氣息 園區內潮溼 漫步時請小心慢慢走 如果不想走 園區內也有遊園車可以搭乘

広州郊外にある自然豊かな国立公園。チケットを買って入る有料のエリアが大部分を占めますが、中央を南北に走っている道路のまわりやその中間から東門に抜けるルートなどは無料で２４時間開放されています。無料エリアだけでも、鳥が沢山いたり、蓮の花が咲いているエリア、などありました。この日は５時台からランニングに行ってきました。公園の東側、南側のヘリを通り、真ん中のルートを使って公園の右側を１周して８ＫＭ、のんびり走って１時間くらい。週末は走る人が結構いますが平日は人も少なく快適です。
สวนเขียวชอุ่ม ร่มรื่นมาก สามารถใช้เวลาทั้งวันในการเดินเที่ยว สามารถนั่งเรือชมบรรยากาศ ขึ้นลงได้ 4 จุด เหมาะกับการมาพักผ่อน
終於來到名單裡的一個重要景點✌️🤩 特別要了一艘老式的擼擼船 當地人的船夫在這慢遊的三個小時裡 說說當地的人文佚事👍 更能請他代點幾道本地菜餚 再下一個小碼頭有阿姨把熱騰騰的菜端上來 再慢慢地享用美食+美景❤️ 真享受這一個半天的美好時光😍😘
杭州市の西湖区と余杭区にまたがって広がっている湿地を中心とした公園。西湖から西へ5kmくらいのところにある。面積は11.5平方キロメートルと広大で、園内には6つの川が流れている。とてもではないが歩いて全て見ることはできないスケール。ひたすら川、ジャングル。

搭船遊西溪濕地 下雨有雨中的美 西溪古稱河渚，「曲水彎環，群山四繞，名園古剎，前後接，又多蘆汀沙溆」 分為中部濕地生態保護種植區、中部濕地生態旅遊休閒區及西部濕地生態景觀封育區 濕地植物園 總佔地約55公頃，是以西溪富有特色的基塘系統、河流灘渚等生態多樣性中的濕地植物的展示以及全國範圍內水生、濕生植物的收集、栽培和展覽為主要內容，以休閒遊覽、科研科普教育、水生植物的配植示範和引種繁殖為主要功能的濕地植物園 目前共培育濕地植物600多種，其中喬木100餘種，濕生灌木地被近250種，挺水植物150餘種， 漂浮植物30餘種，浮葉植物50餘種，沈水植物30餘種 西溪地水系縱橫交錯、蓄積鱗次櫛比，西溪濕地一二期範圍內河流總長為83.36公里，河道總長104公里，西溪濕地濕度魚塘為1066個 西溪地河流水面面積為4.31米，地下水位湖泊面積為3.51米，這總計佔總面積的68.02%。河川蓄水量為862萬立方米，蓄水池蓄水量為526萬立方米，總計1388萬立方公尺。
บรรยากาศดี สถานที่สวยงาม ธรรมชาติใกล้ตัว มาเดินเล่น นั่งเรือเล่น หรือจะนั่งรถชมรอบๆก็มีให้บริการ ห้องน้ำสะอาด
天然美景，人工保護，一股濃濃詩情畫意，浪漫至極的地方。 西溪且留下。與西湖、西泠並稱三西的西溪，這一種詩情畫意，身歷其境後，才能感受它的美麗。難怪徐志摩到此，會留下那麼一首情意綿綿的傳世佳作。 園區大，草木多，也潮濕，蚊子不少，建議做好防護措施。
位於杭州市西郊離西湖不到5公里，是罕見的城中次生濕的是目前中國第一個也是唯一的集城市的農耕濕地、文化濕地一體的國家濕地公園，微電影非誠勿擾的外景地，尋者電影中的足跡而去回歸真正純粹的大自然感受，ㄧ曲溪流1曲煙的美妙意境。溪之勝在於水，70%的面積與6條河流 縱橫交滙，形成了西溪獨特的濕地景緻
Không gian yên tĩnh, hệ sinh thái của công viên phong phú, đi thuyền trên các con kênh cảm giác nhẹ nhàng, thư giãn. Trong công viên cũng có bán đồ ăn cũng như quà lưu niệm

Muy bonito el parque de humedales sobre todo Cómo cuidan la limpieza del área excelente para que las personas puedan ir a visitar
西溪濕地“一曲溪流一曲煙”這句是廣為流傳的西溪美景寫真語句，而“冷、野、淡、雅”則是西溪濕地的精神凝聚。西溪的景色特點以天然質樸為美，冷，就是幽寂、冷靜，好似都市裏的一帖寧靜劑；野，就是天然、野趣，宛如紅塵中的原始淨土；淡，就是淡泊、清遠，能使人領悟回歸自然；雅，就是文雅、高雅，尋常處可感受到濃郁的文化氣息。

很好的地方，居家旅遊朋友聚會適合一遊！這個季節正好是出來玩的好時節！坐船人特別多，花花草草感覺特別好！有時間一定要再來體驗一下。
